skill_tree.jujutsukaisenzone.judgment_si:
Marks a target with an affliction for 8 minutes; repeated hits neither stack nor extend it.

Misdeeds in the world recorded by the shikigami Judge, or a Guilty verdict from Trial, Accuse, or domain trial, can inflict Sinful One and add a crime record.

Targets with Sinful One are always Guilty when judged by Trial or domain Trial.
skill_tree.jujutsukaisenzone.judgment_do:
When the barrier finishes building, everyone inside is frozen (cannot move, temporarily invulnerable, and cannot use technique skills); black sky seals the domain, the execution scaffold rises at center, and a Judge appears above the caster.

About 8 s later, defendants are seated by distance from center (nearest first); overflow stands in the outer ring. With exactly 1 defendant, the caster clicks Start Trial in chat—same flow as Accuse; with 2 or more, each seat is judged in turn using Trial rules; crimes and verdicts broadcast to everyone in the domain.

During trial, only announcements and title effects play; Confiscation, Sinful One, and Death Sentence apply when the domain closes (Death Sentence in single-defendant trial may apply earlier). The domain auto-dismisses after all verdicts; the caster skips Technique Meltdown only on that auto-close (manual dismiss still triggers meltdown).

Multi-defendant: guilty chance per seat matches Trial (10%% base + trial stack on that target); Death Sentence rolls after Guilty match Trial; targets gain 15 s Slowness after each verdict. Single-defendant: Crime Confirmed evidence is 30%% base + trial stack (Sinful One always confirmed); debuff stack only on Deny + Crime Confirmed Death Sentence rolls, same as Accuse.

Appeal: After the domain closes, defendants ruled Guilty in that session have a 1-minute appeal window. Player defendants send "上诉" in chat; non-players may also appeal. A successful appeal instantly reopens Deadly Sentencing for a single-defendant retrial (same flow as Accuse). Acquittal (Deny + Cannot Confirm) revokes Death Sentence and Confiscation; a second Guilty verdict applies normal punishment with no further appeal. Closing the domain after an appeal does not trigger domain cooldown.

After the domain closes (manual dismiss or auto-dismiss after verdicts), a 10 s cooldown applies. If you expand again within 30 s of the last close and that domain closes successfully, the cooldown after that close is 20 s.
skill_tree.jujutsukaisenzone.limitless_d: Race through the gap between "Infinity" and reality, pull enemies into the "inside" of Infinity, and flood their minds with endless information until they lose consciousness. Those pressed close at your side are spared.
skill_tree.jujutsukaisenzone.shrine_doma: Black sky seals the barrier first; the Demon-Subduing Shrine rises north of center and teleports you before it. For a breathless pre-combat stillness, nothing moves—then the sky turns blood-red and the shrine's slashes fall on every target in the domain. Hold your lock on one target long enough, and a heavier Power Slash descends upon them—nowhere to run.
skill_tree.jujutsukaisenzone.love_rendez:
Shift + skill key: brand yourself with the current mark. A self-mark is identical to any other mark and spends cursed energy under the Star Mark skill's own unlock and level; if any mark already sits on you, it becomes a free self-clear instead.

Ctrl + skill key: targeted clear - remove every mark bearing the current star, your own included, and break off any pull anchored to that star.

Rapidly double-tap Shift in combat mode: if the crosshair rests on a marked block, item or entity, that single target is cleared; if it does not, every mark you hold is cleared. The crosshair check has no range limit and ignores obstruction.

In combat mode, press the middle mouse button to cycle to the Star Mark adjust mode, then use mouse buttons 4 / 5 to switch the current mark.

There are five marks, in the order Imai - Acrux - Mimosa - Ginan - Gacrux, each tied to a debuff: Imai slows, Acrux weakens attacks, Mimosa glows and strips armor, Ginan briefly confuses, Gacrux freezes and binds.

The instant the domain expands, hostile stars sitting too close to each other are blown apart by a single shock: a block knocks away an entity, and between two entities the one with more max health knocks away the one with less.

The launch speed scales inversely with domain size - the smaller the domain, the greater the kick. The kicked star's own stack level carries it further still, up to double at full stacks. In flight, entering another same-star mark's attraction range tugs it gently toward that star, but the faster it flies the less that pull can correct its course - the shot is ultimately your own to aim.

When a launched star strikes another marked star, both sides take a single impact each, scaled by the speed at the moment of collision.

Requires a mark on yourself (Shift + skill key marks yourself) plus a fully stacked entity mark on the target, and the target must be a markable mob; blocks and dropped items cannot be the subject of a rendezvous, though they can serve as waypoints along the chain.

Whether the kick flings is fully under your control - it depends only on which star you have selected. The freshly applied mark also restores the target's status as a 'ball': in flight it is steered by same-star attraction, and hitting another mark still resolves impact damage.

Terrain and gates no longer block the flight, and the kick curves toward a moving target. If the target vanishes or escapes beyond twice the range, the flight aborts with no effect.

Domain Expansion: Love Rendezvous. Inside the domain, this technique's one-target-at-a-time clearing links into a chain.

- Impact lights it: when a ball hits a mark inside the domain, the struck mark detonates on the spot.
- The fire spreads harder: a clean target caught in the blast becomes fully stacked at once, ready as the next fuse, and same-star marks already inside the domain are pulled to full as well.
- The ball stops missing: inside the domain it steers all the way into the nearest mark that can take a hit.

Close the domain and all three drop at once; the technique returns to its ordinary rules outside.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.limitless_blue.d: Pulls targets and blocks. Deals %s damage every %s ticks within %s blocks; pull range %s blocks. Hold to charge for Max Output (2× cost).
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.limitless_blue.b: Negative, converging, inward. Everything nearby is drawn in - blocks included - and ground down at the centre of the pull.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.limitless_red.de: Repulsion burst with explosion power %s; launched blocks deal %s damage per block traveled. Hold to charge for Max Output (2× cost).
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.limitless_red.br: Positive, repelling, outward. One blow shoves everything before you away, and the blocks it launches are a second wound of their own.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.limitless_purple: Fires a Purple arrow. Sphere radius %s blocks, %s damage per tick. Hold to charge for Max Output (2× cost).
What remains after Blue and Red collide. Fire it, and everything the sphere passes over keeps being cut.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.limitless_remote: Hold for %s s to finish the startup, then auto-fires ultra-long-range Purple. Sphere radius %s blocks, %s damage per tick, max flight %s chunks. Release early to cancel.
Purple, pushed to an unreasonable distance. Hold to finish the startup and the sphere flies out on its own, past mountains and horizon. Release early, and it is void.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.shrine_kai.desc: Slash forward. Column radius %s blocks, %s damage per tick.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.shrine_kai.brief: One sweep forward. The slash spreads along the arc you cut into a column, and everything in its path is opened.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.shrine_kai_flyob: Fire a cutting projectile along your gaze. Range %s blocks, column radius %s blocks, %s damage per tick.
Where your gaze reaches, the cut has already arrived. A slash loosed along your sight, leaving a line of wounds on everything it crosses.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.shrine_hachi.des: Applies Dismantle to targets within %s blocks in front of you. %s damage every %s ticks.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.shrine_hachi.bri: The Shrine's second blade. It falls on the target before you again and again, and time becomes one cut after another.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.shrine_fuga.desc: Hold for %s s then release to fire a flame arrow. Impact radius %s blocks, lasts %s s, %s damage per tick. Release early to cancel.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.shrine_fuga.brie: Hold, and loose an arrow. Where it lands, fire takes hold - and for as long as it burns, no one standing inside it has a moment's peace.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.judgment_gavel.d: On cast, grants a Gavel if you don't already carry one; if you already have one, cycles to the next form (requires the Three-Form Gavel node; without it the Gavel is locked to its Standard form). Right-click while holding the Gavel to fire it instantly—Standard form direct hit deals %s damage; impact explosion power %s and does not break blocks. Gavel attacks against Sinful One targets deal %s%% bonus damage (melee, projectile, and explosion). When Trial, Accuse, or domain trial inflicts Death Sentence on a creature, your Gavel becomes the Executioner's Sword; if you have no Gavel, you receive the sword directly. The Executioner's Sword instantly executes targets under Death Sentence. After 5 minutes, the sword reverts to a Gavel.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.judgment_gavel.b:
The gavel that walks beside you, and the instrument that waits above every guilty head. Throw it and the impact bursts; against a Sinful One it bites deeper.

When a Death Sentence is handed down in your court, it becomes the Executioner's Sword - and that blow spares no one. The sword has its hour; once it passes, it is a gavel again.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.judgment_trial.d:
Lock onto an enemy with Epic Fight for %s s; taking damage while charging cancels it. After charging, a Judge passes judgment: %s%% base Guilty (Innocent does nothing). Sinful One targets are always Guilty.

Each completed use of this skill on a target (including Innocent) adds +%s%% guilty chance next time you use this skill on them (max +%s%%).

On Guilty: Sinful One for 8 minutes (no refresh) and the crime is read aloud. Punishment: %s%% base Death Sentence, else Confiscation; if Death Sentence, %s%% chance of Death Sentence with Confiscation. Each affliction on the target adds +%s%% to those Death Sentence rolls (cap +%s%%).

After the verdict, the target gains 15 s Slowness regardless of outcome. Cursed energy and cooldown apply when charging completes.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.judgment_trial.b:
Your lock is the summons. The Judge steps up behind you and reads the charge: the Guilty take Sinful One and then either Confiscation or Death Sentence, the Innocent walk away untouched.

The more often you judge someone, the harder it gets for them to walk away next time.
Fix your gaze on a target; a Judge follows and reads a random charge. Player defendants have %s s—1 Deny, 2 Lie, 3 Confess; non-players respond automatically. Silence: Confiscation, Sinful One, 3 s immobilization.

Crime Confirmed evidence: %s%% base, plus your trial stack on that target (+%s%% per completed Trial on them, max +%s%%; Accuse does not add stack).

Verdicts—Deny + Confirmed: Death Sentence or Confiscation (%s%% base Death Sentence, +%s%% per harmful debuff, cap +%s%%); Deny + Cannot Confirm: acquittal; Lie + Confirmed: Confiscation and Sinful One; Lie + Cannot Confirm: Confiscation; Confess + Confirmed: Confiscation; Confess + Cannot Confirm: Sinful One.
A random charge is read aloud, and the defence is handed to the accused: deny, lie, or confess. Three stances against two findings make six verdicts. Stay silent, and you have waived your defence.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.judgment_view_fi: Fix your gaze upon another sorcerer and open their filed dossier—faction, innate technique, cursed energy, and mastery of auxiliary arts unfold in your chat alone.
Look at someone and you know what they are. Faction, innate technique, cursed energy, and every art they have mastered, laid out as a dossier that opens for your eyes alone.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.judgment_gavel_f:
Unlocks the Gavel's other two forms: press the skill key again while holding the Gavel to cycle Standard → Long Handle → Big Hammer. Without this node the Gavel is locked to its Standard form.

Long Handle: slower attacks and longer reach; throws farther with a longer cooldown.

Big Hammer: slower attacks and higher damage; throws hit much harder with a stronger block-breaking explosion, but shorter range, slower projectile speed, and a longer cooldown.
One gavel, three grips. Standard, Long Handle, Big Hammer - the long handle reaches farther, the big hammer hits harder, and each asks for something back.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.judgment_sentenc: Once unlocked, the verdict gains a Death Sentence tier: a Guilty verdict has a %s%% chance to be executed outright, otherwise Confiscation stands.
It gives the verdict one more place to land. After Guilty there is no longer only Confiscation: that roll may fall straight to Death Sentence.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.judgment_aggrava:
Once unlocked, the Death Sentence roll gains two bonuses on top of its base chance:

1. Each affliction on the target: +%s%% (up to +%s%% in total).

2. The graver the charge read aloud, the larger the bonus.

Both apply to the Death Sentence rolls of Trial, Accuse, and domain trial alike.
The graver the crime, the closer the sentence. Every affliction the target carries, and the weight of the charge read aloud, both push Death Sentence upward.
skill.jujutsukaisenzone.love_rendezvous_:
Strike an entity in melee, or aim at a block and press the Star Mark skill key, to brand it with the current mark; cursed energy is spent when the mark lands. A target bears at most one mark: re-applying the same star stacks its star rank, while a different star replaces it (rank resets to 1). A single star may be given to any number of different targets. You may hold at most %s marks at once; going over evicts the one you left untouched longest, and a mark dissolves once it is more than %s blocks away, on a dimension change, when its block is broken, or when its target vanishes.

Star rank caps at %s and decays over time: one rank drops every %s s since your last mark, down to a floor of 1. Applying the same star once more at max rank detonates the mark: it is consumed entirely, targets within %s blocks take that star's debuff, the marked core itself alone takes %s single-target damage (nothing nearby is hurt), and unmarked targets are infected with a rank-1 mark of the same star.

Brand a person, a block, or a dropped item with a star. Stack the same star to its full rank, then apply it once more to detonate - those nearby take that star's affliction, and the core alone takes the damage.

A star rank fades on its own with time.

Anchor on yourself and drag every target bearing the current mark within %s blocks toward you, for %s seconds.

Same-mark objects already attract one another; while pulling, they converge on you with far greater force.
Anchor on yourself and drag everyone bearing the same star toward you. Like stars drift together by nature; this one hauls.

Using the mark on yourself as the star of departure, charge at a target within %s blocks whose mark is fully stacked: your gates are closed instantly, then you fly straight at the target with high-speed homing.

[Impact] On contact three things resolve in order - first the fully stacked mark it carries is detonated, then impact damage (base %s, heavier the more star ranks you passed through; see the 'Star Crossing' node) is dealt while the star you currently have selected is applied to the target, and finally that fresh mark is compared with the mark on yourself: if the two stars are a counter pair (at least one star apart in sequence), the target is kicked away as a counter burst (the caster always kicks the target); otherwise the kick lands but flings nothing. The detonation of the old mark adds %s single-target damage and consumes it.

[In flight] Other entities along the path are struck once each for %s damage and knocked aside; the final target of this flight is spared that hit, since it is resolved by the kick alone.

Take the star on yourself as the point of departure and charge a fully stacked target. On contact the old mark detonates, the impact lands, and a fresh mark is laid down - and if the two stars are a counter pair, the target is kicked away.

Anything else caught along the flight takes its one hit.

Unfold a star field whose radius follows the Barrier Radius adjust mode (default %s blocks, max %s blocks). The star field has no time limit - it stays until you dismiss it with Ctrl + skill key. Within it, stars can only approach the next one in sequence: a freshly applied mark can reach only its own neighbours, and touching a star unlocks it and its neighbours, so the whole chain must be walked step by step. An unlock lasts only %s s - the innate neighbour relation never expires, but unlocks earned by contact lapse, so walking the whole chain buys a time-limited window rather than permanent immunity.
Unfold a star field and seal its stars into a single order: you walk it rank by rank, and only then may you approach the next. What you earn at the end is a window, not a permanent immunity.

A ball launched by Star Crash! that passes near a block mark of its own star treats that block as a massive body and slingshots off it.

It triggers once the ball is within %s blocks of the block mark: horizontal speed +%s blocks/tick (capped at %s), plus a light lift that gets the ball off the ground again and keeps it flying as a ball. The exit direction re-aims at the next strikable target, so a ball slingshots its way from block to block, faster each time.

Each ball can slingshot at most %s times, and the same block only once; being kicked again resets the count.
A launched ball that skims a block mark of its own star treats that block as a massive body and slingshots off it - re-aiming at the next strikable target, faster every time.

Once unlocked, casting Flight Through while standing inside your own star field lays out a series of passes before take-off: for each star rank this field has unlocked, in sequence, the nearest already-marked entity / block / dropped item becomes a waypoint, and you pass through them one by one; ranks with nothing reachable are skipped, so you only pass through as many as you can find.

Each pass adds +%s%% to the final kick's damage, up to +%s%% (passing through never consumes or detonates the mark it flies past - it is only a signpost).
Take off from inside your own star field, and you will pass through its unlocked ranks one by one first. The more you pass, the heavier the final kick lands.
message.jujutsukaisenzone.reverse_techni: On the brink of death, you grasped Reverse Cursed Technique.
message.jujutsukaisenzone.reverse_studyb: You struggle to grasp the ideas in this book—you need more knowledge.
You understand the concept of outputting positive cursed energy, but you cannot imagine how to do it.
Stack and multiply two flows of cursed energy and inject them into the technique—is that the core?
You have fully mastered this book and cannot raise the learn chance further.
You already know Reverse Cursed Technique.
message.jujutsukaisenzone.barrier_studyb: This book tells you that vast cursed energy can seal space within a barrier.
The ways it discusses influencing space are ancient and profound.
The power to command a patch of space... perhaps you can try tomorrow?
You have finished the book—try casting a barrier after you wake.
message.jujutsukaisenzone.barrier_techni: In your sleep, you grasped the basics of Barrier Technique.
After a full day of practice, your Barrier Technique reached: %s
message.jujutsukaisenzone.domain_expansi: In the depths of your mind, you glimpsed your own domain.
message.jujutsukaisenzone.domain_studybo: You cannot understand it at all.
For the first time, you learn that everyone has their own innate domain—their inner world.
Materializing space that does not exist is hard to imagine. If you could use Barrier Technique somehow......
You grasp how to build an innate domain within a barrier and load it with a sure-hit technique—but only in theory.
You have fully mastered this book and cannot raise the entry chance further.
message.jujutsukaisenzone.soul_studybook: The text only appears in the Nether—you must study this manual there.
The manual says cursed-energy echoes of the dead gather thickest in the Nether.
Seance Technique is aligning your cursed energy with the imprint of another technique.
You recite the final visualization until echo and self briefly overlap in your mind.
message.jujutsukaisenzone.seance_techniq: You grasp the basics of Seance Technique—you can mimic another's technique through residual echoes.
After a full day of practice, your Seance Technique reached: %s
